title: Amara, Ethan and the people around them
summary: Ethan is Amara's child. After her long relationship with Victor ended, she had Ethan with a wealthy man who provided for their future. Ethan's father has since died. Amara later fell in love with David, a web developer with hacking skills who believes every system has something he can decode. Victor cannot accept her choice: he takes credit for what other people built and treats Amara's independence as a betrayal. David is trying to bring Amara's child home; he is not Ethan's biological father.
continuing_story_rule: Wins uncover evidence and narrowly missed opportunities. Losses remain on the same level and show Victor's threats. Ethan is never rescued in the continuing campaign; a rescue would end this story.
failure_taunts: I told you, David. You won't return alive.
You decoded a clue. I have already left.
Another empty room, David. Did you expect applause?
Amara will remember who holds the next move.
All those clever answers, and you are still behind me.
You want to be the hero? Come and find me.
I made the plan. You are only following it.
Tell Amara whose name she should be thanking.
One door too late, David. Again.
You cannot decode your way out of every mistake.
Keep chasing. I will choose where we meet.

roles.amara: Ethan's mother. She knows her own history and makes her own decisions.
roles.ethan: Amara's child with his deceased wealthy father.
roles.david: Amara's partner, a web developer and hacker. His confidence in decoding systems is both useful and a source of mistakes.
roles.victor: Amara's former long-term partner. He claims other people's achievements, resents her independence and wants the credit and control he believes he deserves.
roles.detective_morris: The investigator brought into the active story when the player chooses police assistance.
